items.title: Continual Learning Mechanisms Compose for Long-Horizon Memorization
items.summary: Researchers introduce a novel approach where continual learning mechanisms are composed to achieve long-horizon memorization, addressing a critical challenge in AI systems.

items.title: Build real-time voice applications with Gemini 3.8 Live and 3.5 Transcribe
items.summary: Google AI announces new capabilities with Gemini 3.8 Live and 3.5 Transcribe, enabling developers to create real-time voice applications with enhanced accuracy and speed.

items.title: Your startup’s next teammate might be an AI agent: Gusto, Insight Partners, and Leland explain what that changes at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
items.summary: Industry leaders at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 discuss the growing trend of AI agents becoming integral team members in startups and the implications for business operations.

items.title: AI for Games in the Foundation Model Era
items.summary: This paper explores the transformative potential of foundation models in revolutionizing AI applications within the gaming industry, from NPC behavior to content generation.

items.title: StepAudio 3 Realtime Technical Report
items.summary: A technical report details StepAudio 3, showcasing advancements in real-time audio generation that could significantly impact creative and interactive applications.

items.title: The Last AI Built by Humans: Toward Genuine Recursive Self-Improvement
items.summary: This paper delves into the theoretical and practical challenges of building AI capable of genuine recursive self-improvement, potentially leading to advanced general intelligence.

items.title: ScienceIDE: Turning World's Scientific Codebase into Agent Learnable Environments
items.summary: ScienceIDE proposes transforming the global scientific codebase into learnable environments for AI agents, aiming to accelerate scientific discovery and research.

items.title: openarm: A fully open-source humanoid arm for physical AI research and deployment in contact-rich environments
items.summary: The openarm project releases a fully open-source humanoid arm designed for physical AI research and deployment, particularly in environments requiring complex physical interaction.

items.title: Al Gore says the real AI risk isn’t data centers
items.summary: Al Gore offers a nuanced perspective on AI risks, suggesting that the primary concerns lie beyond the environmental impact of data centers, hinting at broader societal implications.

items.title: StepAudio 3 Music Technical Report
items.summary: A companion technical report for StepAudio 3 focuses specifically on its capabilities for music generation, detailing new methods and results.

items.title: Grouped Value Attention: Efficient KV Caching via On-Demand Key Reconstruction
items.summary: Researchers propose Grouped Value Attention, an efficient KV caching mechanism that uses on-demand key reconstruction to improve performance in large language models.

items.title: Generalized Agent Iteration: One Formal Framework for Iterative Policy Improvement and Recursive Self-Improvement
items.summary: A new formal framework, Generalized Agent Iteration, is introduced to unify iterative policy improvement and recursive self-improvement, advancing the theoretical understanding of AI agents.

items.title: LynnReal-Omni: Native multi-modal Video Generation for Agentic Visual Workflows
items.summary: LynnReal-Omni presents a new approach to native multi-modal video generation, specifically designed to support agentic visual workflows with high fidelity.

items.title: AI for Societal Impact
items.summary: Google AI outlines its initiatives and research focus on leveraging artificial intelligence to address pressing societal challenges and create positive global impact.

items.title: Helping older adults use AI in everyday life
items.summary: OpenAI details its efforts and strategies to make AI more accessible and beneficial for older adults, integrating AI tools into their daily routines.
